messages:
kevin: Quick heads-up — partner X just pushed a new driver build (525.60) upstream and their marketplace image is tagged. We need to decide pinning vs. immediate hotfix path. They reported a perf regression in long-context Llama-style models.

rachel: Ugh. Any customer impacts reported yet?

maria: No active alerts from SRE but our nightly evaller flagged token generation timeouts on 4k+ contexts in the canary run. Repro steps attached in the CI log.

kevin: Link to partner release notes: https://partnerx.example.com/releases/525.60 (they removed a custom kernel patch). They also bumped ROCm runtime in the image.

aj: tl;dr from ops: images built w/ driver 525.60 + cuda 12.2, but marketplace image ID differs from our pinned marketplace builds. For Dedicated customers we currently ship 525.50 + cuda 11.8.

dylan: Proposed options:
1) pin Marketplace + Dedicated to 525.50 / CUDA 11.8 for the next 48h and ask partner to ship hotpatch for the regression.
2) accept 525.60 but gate via canary policy and add a weight-limited runway for customers.
3) roll back partner image in marketplace (needs partner consent).

nate: I lean toward option 1 for safety — regression appears to be P0 for a subset of long-context workloads. We can soften impact by doing a staged push to non-prod and external customers first.

maria: We should also update our compatibility matrix and marketplace docs. I can prepare the PR, but we'll need marketplace signing/scan done before re-publishing pinned images.

kevin: If we pin, create a short guidance snippet for SI partners and MSPs: which kernel/module combos we test, how to reproduce the regression, and the hotfix checklist. Sample snippet:

```
Test matrix (short):
- Driver: 525.50 (validated)
- CUDA: 11.8 (validated)
- ROCm: 5.6 (validated)
- Kernel: 5.15.x or 6.1.x (validated)
Repro: run lm_infer --model llama-13b --context 8192 --batch 1 --measure latency
Expected symptom: KV cache stall and token throughput drop >20% on 8k+ contexts
```

rachel: Also: announce to partners slack and set embargo for public announcement until partner confirms hotfix timeline. We don't want marketplace consumers to pick up an image with regressions. :warning:

hw-partner-bot: partner X notified: "Requesting rollback or hotfix target. Can you pin marketplace image to 525.50 while we triage?" (automated)

aj: Action items per sprint:
- @maria: PR for marketplace pin + docs (ETA 4h)
- @nate: schedule canary testing window and update rollout policy to 10% for 525.60 if we go that route (ETA 2h)
- @kevin: talk to partner product to agree rollback vs hotpatch (ETA 3h)
- @rachel: coordinate partner comms and embargo (ETA 1h)
- @dylan: prepare patches in our dedicated images builder to force 525.50 if pin approved (ETA 6h)

kevin: One more ask — please add a short regression test to the nightly evaller that exercises 4k/8k KV cache paths and fails CI if throughput regresses >15% vs baseline. That will help catch similar surprises going forward.

maria: Will add to evaller with a small benchmark harness.

rachel: I'll set a partner sync call in 30m to lock decisions. If partner confirms hotfix ETA < 24h we can consider soft-gating 525.60 with canary; otherwise we pin.

nate: Noted. Logging this thread for release notes and marketplace audit.

ops-bot: Deploy ticket created: TKT-7482 (marketplace pin + scans). Assigned to maria, dylan.

kevin: Thanks team — keep updates here. If we get a hotfix build from partner, post checksum + signed image before we re-publish. :thumbsup:
